common_request_inheritance.rule: directions, weights, background_q1, background_mid, background_q3, opacity_mid, step_size, gamma, opacity_scale, tilt_axis, C-contiguity, finite checks, Type-II domain guard, and existing exception classes are byte-for-byte semantic inheritances from v1.

identity.identity_equivalence_rule: For identical validated directions, weights, and remap_plan, this direct result is byte-identical to trajectory_result.execution_identity and batch_result.execution_identity. The symbol has no mutable process-global invocation state.

carrier.rule: Any other carrier is RF04_UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY through RF04CapabilityError. Input is rejected rather than silently projected.

quadrature_route.rule: Different valid route tokens are never silently equated in execution identity or output.

direction_grid_sha256.rule: Matches the direction-grid canonical bytes declared below.

plan_sha256.rule: Must equal SHA-256 of the exact remap-plan canonical bytes declared below.

input_policy.rule: Reject the caller input when the absolute maximum packed-component difference between the input and its screen projection exceeds 1e-10. Do not invoke ScreenInputPolicy::Project for any public v2 input.

input_realizability.rule: After Reject-mode screen validation, apply the final donor's existing validate_realizable_screen_state rule with tolerance 1e-10. At a node with positive intensity I the absolute tolerance is 1e-10*I; otherwise it is 1e-10. Reject screen transversality leakage above that tolerance or a coherency minimum eigenvalue below minus that tolerance.

output_acceptance.rule: Apply the same final-donor realizability rule to the stored accepted state after the final screen projection. A checked nonfinite arithmetic or certificate failure is not converted into a projection success.

direction_grid.bytes: ASCII bass-rf04-direction-grid/v1\0 followed by M as unsigned-64 little-endian, then directions row-major IEEE-754 binary64 bits little-endian, then weights IEEE-754 binary64 bits little-endian.

remap_plan.bytes: UTF-8 canonical JSON with this exact ordered field sequence: schema_id, direction_grid_sha256, target_offsets, source_indices, weights_binary64_hex, builder_id, builder_version, minimum_transport_dot_binary64_hex. target_offsets and source_indices are JSON decimal unsigned integers; each float entry is a 16-lowercase-hex IEEE-754 binary64 bit string without a 0x prefix; separators are comma and colon only; no whitespace; ASCII identifiers only.
remap_plan.rule: The plan_sha256 field is excluded from the canonical bytes to avoid a self-reference.

backtrace_direction.bytes: ASCII bass-rf04-backtrace-direction/v1\0 followed by M as unsigned-64 little-endian, then the backtraced directions in accepted target-node order as 3*M IEEE-754 binary64 bit patterns little-endian. The values are the exact direction values used by the accepted step; no post-hash normalization or sorting is permitted.

spatial_transport.bytes: ASCII bass-rf04-spatial-transport/v1\0 followed by M as unsigned-64 little-endian, then the accepted spatial transport matrices in target-node order as 9*M row-major IEEE-754 binary64 bit patterns little-endian.

receipt.bytes: UTF-8 canonical JSON using exactly canonical_json_fields in that order; all SHA-256 values are lowercase hexadecimal strings; step and count fields are decimal unsigned integers; the two floating diagnostics are 16-lowercase-hex IEEE-754 binary64 bit strings without a 0x prefix; separators are comma and colon only; no whitespace.
receipt.self_reference_rule: receipt_sha256 and receipt_chain_head_sha256 are derived fields and are excluded from the receipt bytes.

chain.next_head: For zero-based accepted step i, H_(i+1) = SHA-256(ASCII bass-rf04-geometry-receipt-chain/v1\0 || unsigned-64-little-endian(i) || H_i || hex_decode(receipt_sha256)).
chain.aggregation_rule: The trajectory exposes geometry_receipt_chain_head_sha256 equal to H_K. A restart may continue only when its supplied predecessor head equals H_K byte-for-byte.

dynamic_value_rules.route_schema_sha256: SHA-256 of the inherited exact PUBLIC_ROUTE_SCHEMA_DELTA_V2.json bytes.
dynamic_value_rules.authority_decisions_sha256: SHA-256 of the inherited exact AUTHORITY_DECISIONS.json bytes.
dynamic_value_rules.direction_grid_sha256: Derived from the exact validated directions and weights using identity_codecs.direction_grid. The supplied remap_plan.direction_grid_sha256 must equal this digest.

exact_wheel_sha256.rule: The exact installed wheel SHA-256 is mandatory immutable local evidence, is checked by clean-wheel readback, and is forbidden from execution_identity.

execution_identity.encoding: Same canonical JSON UTF-8 codec as RF04 public v1. No Python dict repr, unordered map serialization, mutable process-global payload identity, installation-path metadata, or wheel SHA-256 is allowed in execution_identity.

execution_identity.semantics: Byte-identical to rf04_typeii_polarized_execution_identity_v2(directions, weights, remap_plan) after the same validations.

v2_semantics.raw_pre_projection_screen_leakage: For accepted outer step i, the maximum absolute packed-component difference between the complete raw accepted-step candidate and its final screen projection, measured after the K-C-G-C-K composition and immediately before final projection. This is an output diagnostic, not an input acceptance relaxation.
v2_semantics.post_projection_screen_leakage: For accepted outer step i, the maximum screen leakage of the projected state that is stored as radiation_history row i. It is evaluated immediately after final projection and before history serialization.
v2_semantics.screen_leakage: For polarized-v2 output, inherited screen_leakage is an alias of post_projection_screen_leakage and must be byte-identical elementwise.
v2_semantics.minimum_coherency_eigenvalue: For polarized-v2 output, each value is the minimum physical two-by-two Hermitian coherency eigenvalue over all nodes of the stored accepted state for that outer step.

geometry_receipts.serialization: Use geometry_receipt_codecs.receipt. Public float fields maximum_screen_leakage and minimum_coherency_eigenvalue are decoded from the canonical binary64 fields; their canonical receipt bytes always use the hex fields.
geometry_receipts.order: Receipt i is the unique accepted outer step with step_index i in zero-based accepted-step order. geometry_receipts has K entries, and trajectory_result.geometry_receipt_chain_head_sha256 equals the final receipt chain head.

geometry_receipt_chain_head_sha256.semantics: H_K from geometry_receipt_codecs.chain; for K=0 it is H_0.

execution_identity.semantics: Byte-identical to rf04_typeii_polarized_execution_identity_v2(directions, weights, remap_plan) after the same validations.

member_completed_steps.semantics: For success this is K. For isolated failure this is the number of fully accepted outer steps completed before the first failing step, in the closed interval 0 through K.

member_error_code.semantics: null exactly when member_status is 0; otherwise exactly one allowed typed code from member_status_codes.

batch_result.failure_isolation: A malformed or physically failing individual member receives its input-order row status 1, all-NaN final row, completed-step count, and one exact member_status_codes error code. Common schema, common grid, common plan, route capability, or any failure before member isolation rejects the whole call with an existing typed exception.

exception_mapping.rule: No new Python exception classes are authorized. The existing v1 mapper class family is exhaustive.
